summary: A string is text in quotes. Use len() to count its characters, an index to get one character, and == to compare two strings.
notes: len(song) counts every character, including spaces.
song[0] is the first character. song[len(song) - 1] is the last.
== compares the text, and the comparison is case-sensitive.
pitfall: Joining a str and an int with + causes TypeError: can only concatenate str (not "int") to str. Use str() or a comma in print().
